title: Bapat–Lal's monotonicity conjecture for the μ-permanent
statement: Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Hermitian positive definite nondiagonal matrix, and let $P_\mu(A)$ denote its μ-permanent. **Bapat–Lal's conjecture.** $P_\mu(A)$ is a strictly increasing function of $\mu\in[-1,1]$. This extends the corresponding monotonicity known for some matrix sizes and graph classes; the general assertion is presented as a conjecture.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.02231

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2018).
source_name: Carlos M. da Fonseca, “The μ-permanent revisited”, arXiv:1804.02231 (2018).
